concerns.text: Task T003 generates salience maps using the GBVS algorithm (CPU‑first) with an optional GPU DeepGaze II fallback. This directly weakens FR‑001, which explicitly requires *all* stimulus images to have pixel‑wise salience maps computed with the DeepGaze II model in CPU‑only mode. Using GBVS as the primary method fails to meet the functional requirement.

The implementation plan’s summary states that the pipeline “computes CPU‑friendly pixel‑wise salience maps … using the GBVS algorithm” as the primary method. This contradicts the specification’s FR‑001 mandate for DeepGaze II CPU‑only salience computation, representing a specification‑to‑plan weakening.
